quests.title: Many Hands Make Light Work

dialogue.t: This furnace is proving more useful than I expected.
Yeah. It was a little unstable at first, but Kresnik Kristall burns much more efficiently with this design.
And thanks to all the maintenance work you two have been doing, the output has finally stabilized.
Kristall is still in short supply, but if we pool together the limited stock we have, there's actually more than enough.
Looks like we won't have to worry about anyone freezing in the near future.
By the way, have any gang members come around lately?
Hmm. Must've been some overeager grunt acting on his own initiative, then. Well, that's one less thing to worry about.
I think it's time to celebrate! Shall I call everyone over so they can meet the heroic young man who established this shelter?
Now's not the time for jokes like that. We're sticking to the story, okay? You established this shelter, and you led them here.

dialogue.sit: Why keep it a secret from everyone?

dialogue.t: Because I'm a member of the Rokot. Keeping a low profile is a matter of principle.

quests.description: The furnace grows hotter and stronger, and life at the shelter has finally stabilized…
